[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I wasn't sure how this production was going to help anything initially, but I was surprised by how well it works. I found this part to be subtle. It was enough to pull some light to my under-eye area, but not glaringly yellow where it looked odd. For the longer term effects, this product seems to do some serious work on puffiness. Puffy eyes do run in my family, but I could see noticeable results after using this for about a week, and it continued to improve from there. I also wanted to see how long it would stay that way, so I gave it a break and unfortunately, the results do fade back to the baseline at about the same rate as I had seen with the improvement. So, skipping a day wouldn't really make a difference, but it does take regular application to keep the benefits consistently. Overall, I was impressed that this product had such good results to show for itself. It was a distinct difference for me.

My right eye is more smooth under my eye and my skin also has a glow to it from using the product. A little goes a long way. I also used ice under my eye to assist with the puffiness, open my pores and help with the product being effective. I recommend however it may take a while to see a change. Consistency is key

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been using the Olehenriksen Banana Bright+ Vitamin C Eye Crème twice a day for three weeks now. The packaging is beautiful and the smell is very neutral (I kind of expected to smell banana). I also didn't notice any "flecks of gold" - the product is just a pale yellow. It is thick and feels very high quality and hydrating on the skin. It's a decent base for makeup application. There is some mild brightening for me; as far as fine lines and dark circles, I haven't noticed much of a change. This doesn't contain caffeine, which is what usually helps with dark circles. This is an average product overall. Not great, but not terrible either. I also think the price is steep for what it delivers. Similar quality products can be found for much less.

avis.titre: Highly effective for reducing fine lines under eyes!
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this Ole Henriksen Banana Bright + Eye Cream! It is effective in making the appearance of your fine lines and wrinkles become less noticeable. Its not sticky and doesn't have any strange smells! It feels weightless when applied to your face. I have noticed a huge change in my skin since I began using this product!! If you want your face to have less fine lines and wrinkles I highly recommend giving this product a chance!!

[I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review]. Thank you to Ole Henriksen for the chance to try their Banana Bright+ Eye Cream. I love the packaging and the glass jar, especially as I try to limit single use plastics. This product is creamy, with no scent and a smooth application. It feels rich, but not overly heavy or thick. It is definitely brightening, and took a few times of consistent day to day application to notice a difference. Only docked one star as this product contains phenoxyethanol, a potential endocrine disruptor, allergen, irritant and environmental pollutant. I would love to see this product reformulated without this ingredient.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Ive been using this cream for some time now. It does a great job of reducing the look of tired eyes, and is an excellent base under makeup. I have not seen a notable change over time in pigmentation but it does keep the skin around my eyes smooth. I experienced no breakouts (despite being acne-prone) or other irritation while using this. Would purchase in the future.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This eye cream is so moisturizing and gives my under-eyes a beautiful, subtle glow. I love that I can wear it both under makeup and on no-makeup days. Every time I use it, I look more awake and refreshed! The consistency is lightweight and never feels heavy or greasy, making it perfect for everyday use.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] While this eye cream is good, its definitely not a magic solution. I've been using it consistently for about a month, and ive seen marginal improvements. It feels nice going on and once its on, it blends nicely

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been reaching for this every morning. It feels really nice, absorbs quickly and keeps my under eye area hydrated. My eyes look a little brighter and more awake! Im glad I gave it a try.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This stuff is GOOD! It's probably one of the best under eye creams I've used in a long time. It's a great texture, glides on easy and a little goes a long way. It also looks great under your makeup. This is something I'd definitely buy & use going forward.

I think I've seen an improvement with my dark circles. Its hard to tell due to my crazy work schedule and not getting a lot of sleep but I'll continue to use it, it's only been a month since I started. I have high hopes for this. It does go on smooth and doesn't feel too heavy.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love the way this product feels under my eye. The texture and absorption of the product makes the product more valuable due to the hydration ingredients.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a lightweight cream that's hydrating and easy to apply. It definitely makes my eyes brighter as described. There's no scent to speak of. Worth a try if you're looking for a brightening cream.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The feel was a 10/10 it was smoothing and it felt good the skin it made it clearer and looks good on me the duration is like 6 hours i would say for me the suitability is good i would say and the longevity is a 7/10 overall it was a good product

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using this cream for couple of weeks now and I really liked it. The banana powder inspired pigments give a soft color correction that wakes up dark circles. This cream is great under makeup, it hydrates well without being greasy, making concealer go on smoothly. It has a light, pleasant citrus scent and feels really refreshing on tired eyes.

avis.titre: Under eye brightener but not permanent fix
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Ole Henriksen Banana Bright+ Eye Cream when applied did reduce some of the dark circles under my eyes. I have an olive skin tone. However, I wouldn't say it removed them as the packaging states. It did brighten my under eyes. I didn't notice a reduction in fine lines or my crows feet though. All and all it's a good under eye brightner, but for the price point I expected more.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love the way this product feels under my eye. The texture and absorption of the product makes the product more valuable due to the hydrating ingredients.

avis.titre: Easy to use product, results yet to be realized
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is an easy to apply under eye cream with no fragrance, and applies like regular lotion or cream. I have used this a few times and yet haven't seen a big brightening appearance. For example, I have a small recent scar under my eye and haven't yet seen it fade in color just yet. I think this would be a great product to use if you're about to do make up as the increased moisture should benefit your under eye application and prevent creasing. I will continue to use the cream and see if it makes a difference!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product was great. Light scent, not too heavy. Feels great on the under eye. I could tell a difference in brightness under my eyes almost immediately. Even my husband could tell a difference if I only put it on one under eye. Would definitely purchase and use daily going forward

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product acrually worked which really surprised me. I usually feel like these products are just gimmicks and didnt think there was a change until I compared my before and after pictures. I like the texture, goes on nicely and doesn't bother my skin nor eyes.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've used other ole Henriksen products and similarly this eye cream did not disappoint. It feels silky on application and a little goes a long way. Will definitely repurchase.

This eye creme surprised me with how well it brightens. In my photos I used it on the right side but not the left and you can really tell the difference! It's moisturizing and clearly skincare rather than makeup, but gives me that extra bit of confidence in my appearance on the days I'm wearing no makeup. It absorbs nicely into the skin and is easy to apply from its container (it's probably a bit too thick for a dispenser so a jar is perfect). I recommend this for no makeup days and for skincare in general as the eye are needs a rich moisturizer.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I started using this so I could use it close to 30 days to give it a good review. My skin doesn't have many problems as I am young but I tried this product and I can see some brightness improvement under my eyes. It does take time and steady usage but I love the feeling of the product and its ease to blend. A lot goes a long way so I've barely made a crater in the product so this will last much longer than 1 month. I love the tiny container so it's easy to take with you on the go. I don't wear makeup so I cannot comment on how it works under makeup. (my scrub cap picture is after)

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this eye cream. I've noticed that my eye area definitely looks more bright and awake after use. A little goes a long way and it's a very light cream so it can be used under makeup with no problems. It won't help with anti aging but if you have dark circles from fatigue this is for you. The packaging is nice as well and feels premium. It has vitamin c and is very moisturizing. I'm definitely keeping this in my skincare routine. (I received this product free in exchange for my honest review)

received this product for free in exchange for an honest review. This eye cream has a smooth thick texture and no scent. I think just a small amount is good enough for both under eyes. I think this helped brighten my under eyes. I have dark circles and they're even more noticeable when I don't get consistent rest or feel stressed. I think I noticed some good results after a few weeks of use.

avis.titre: I will buy this product over and over
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a premium product that comes in a sleek glass designed bottle that looks amazing but performs better. The packaging is very bright and stylish. The product is the best eye cream I have ever used. Absorbs super fast and makes your skin feel super soft. Definitely will be repurchasing this product in the future.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love that this eye cream felt more… "pudding like" Than just a regular cream. Usually I feel like I'm wasting money on eye cream but I could definitely tell the difference between this and my regular face cream. I added some reusable eye patches on top and let it sit - took it to the next level!

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This Ole Henriksen eye cream is amazing! I have used this before about two years ago and I really love that this is now fragrance free. I typically use this in the morning after I cleanse my face. I pat and lightly rub this under my eyes and it applies so smoothly. It is great under makeup because it does not crease my eye concealer. The peach colored tone helps brighten the under eyes as well as the vitamin C in the formula. This is worth every penny.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The banana bright eye cream really works to brighten my under eyes. It has a slight shimmer to it and I like how it hydrated my delicate under eye skin. No irritation and the results seem to get better over time and continued use.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I posted a before and after I feel like I could instantly see how much brighter my face looked after and how my skin appeared less dull than before. I really like how thick the consistency was with my dry skin it felt nice and hydrating. I would repurchase this!

The cream has a smooth texture and feels comfortable around the eyes, without feeling heavy. The overall impression is brightening and hydrating, and early results can make the under-eye area look softer and more refreshed.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The top photo is from before and the bottom is , after about three weeks of use. I'm having a hard time seeing a difference in my Dark circles , but I feel like it helped a little bit. It's easy to apply in a little bit way.
I have been using this eye cream for my am routine for years and it never disappoints! I would never want to be without it!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] You can see the difference between before and after use. Makes under eyes brighter and more hydrated. I have been using at night but still recommend using a sunscreen to protect your skin because of the ingredients. Do not need much to cover the under eye area. Do not notice a scent with it. Would recommend.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have found a new favorite eye cream! The Banana Bright+ eye cream is simply amazing. It brightens my under eyes and makes my face look more alive and extremely hydrated.

avis.titre: A lightweight eye cream that helps my tired toddler-mom eyes
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As a toddler mom, tired eyes are apart of life, so I was excited to try the Ole Henriksen Banana Bright+ Eye Cream. After using it consistently for a week, I've noticed my under-eye area looks brighter, feels more hydrated, and appears more refreshed. The texture is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't feel greasy. A little goes a long way, and I love that it gives my eyes a more awake look even on make up free days. This will definitely become a staple in my morning routine!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I liked the thicker cream texture of this eye cream. It did a great job at hydrating the under eye area and really like that is was unscented. Haven't seen any results in brightening yet, but will continue using it.

The product has a shimmer to it so it did add a slight "glow" under eyes but was covered up once makeup was applied and I only wear a tinted moisturizer. Additionally after using regularly didn't feel skin under eye changed in texture or appearance so not sure I'd actually buy in future

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like the texture. It instantly brightens and hydrates the under eye area and it wears beautifully under makeup. I've been using for a month, but i havent notice any improvement in my dark circles. On the photo I applied on the left side.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Ole Henriksen banana bright eye cream definitely helped puffiness somewhat and moisturized my under eye area. The packaging is cute and it has a good smell.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a decent brightening eye cream from Ole Henriksen. It's a lightweight, hydrating formula with a triple Vitamin C complex to help with brightening. It also has a yellow tint to it to help with color correction, but I personally wouldn't say that I've noticed a difference in my dark circles long term after a few weeks of usage. There's no fragrance, the packaging is nice and sturdy in a glass pot, and a little goes a long way so despite the smaller size size, it'll last a while. It was nice to try but I probably won't repurchase as there are lot of other, more effective options around a similar price points.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The eye cream glides on nicely and does not settle into my fine lines. A little goes a long way. If you use too much it will look cakey and clump. It instantly gives a nice shiny (not greasy) glow to my eyes when I use it.
